name: HLBANK
recent: Hong Leong Bank 公布 2027 财年第一季度净利按年增长 5.1% 至 11.5 亿令吉，主要因减值拨备降低及收入改善。同期，Employees Provident Fund Board 连续多日申报股权变动。此外，公司于 10 月 26 日召开第 85 届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。
notable: 2027 财年第一季度净利按年增长 5.1% 至 11.5 亿令吉。
第 85 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 10 月 26 日举行，所有决议获通过。
Employees Provident Fund Board 在 10 月底至 11 月底期间多次申报股权变动。
risks: Employees Provident Fund Board 近期多次申报股权变动，需关注其持股变化。
earnings: 最近一个季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 17.16 亿令吉，按季增长 10.5%，按年增长 7.9%；净利为 12.43 亿令吉，按季增长 20.7%，按年增长 14.2%；净利率为 72.4%，高于上一季度的 66.3%。

recent_en: Hong Leong Bank reported a 5.1% year-on-year rise in 1Q FY2027 net profit to RM1.15 billion, driven by lower impairment charges and better income. Meanwhile, the Employees Provident Fund Board has been filing continuous changes in its shareholding. The company also held its 85th Annual General Meeting on 26 October 2026, where all resolutions were passed.
notable_en: 1Q FY2027 net profit rose 5.1% year-on-year to RM1.15 billion.
The 85th Annual General Meeting was held on 26 October 2026, with all resolutions passed.
The Employees Provident Fund Board filed multiple changes in its shareholding between late October and late November.
risks_en: The Employees Provident Fund Board has made multiple recent filings on changes in its shareholding, warranting attention to its stake movements.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM1.716 billion, up 10.5% QoQ and 7.9% YoY; net income was RM1.243 billion, up 20.7% QoQ and 14.2% YoY; net margin was 72.4%, higher than 66.3% in the previous quarter.
